review.body:
Re-reviewed current head `98f14a884be87527f0f5cd9b6b3d90b1d5978fb7`. SECURITY-N/A.

The earlier correctness/scope blockers are resolved: matching is normalized inside `get_import_local()`, output casing is preserved, the regression covers both `package["name"]` and `package["exports"]` case mismatches, the unrelated mapping/debug residue is gone, and the PR is now scoped to #312.

One concrete merge blocker remains in the newly added regression: its formatting violates this repository's default Flake8 checks. `tox.ini` runs `flake8 pipreqs tests` without ignoring E231, while the new test contains multiple missing-whitespace cases such as `self,mock_local`, `{"name":"Flask"...}`, and `assertEqual(len(result),1)`. Pycodestyle defines E231 as missing whitespace after `,`, `;`, or `:`. The current Actions runs are `action_required`, so lint has not executed on this head yet.

Please format the new test to satisfy Flake8 (spaces after commas/colons), then re-request review. I found no additional correctness blocker in the case-insensitive matching change itself.

fallback.note: Direct GitHub review write was denied by the integration after exact-head and current-state verification.
